title: Yellow
headline: Chris Martin tried to get rid of the word 'Yellow'
caption:
The band had stepped out of Rockfield for a break after recording "Shiver" when co-producer Ken Nelson told them to look at the stars. So few lights were on that the sky was, in his words, "just amazing".

The line in the song about drawing a line comes from Martin's habit of writing lists and underlining the things on them that matter.

🎧 The song: "Yellow" by Coldplay (@coldplay)

Source: co-producer Ken Nelson (via Wikipedia); Chris Martin on The Howard Stern Show, November 2011 (via Wikipedia); Wikipedia
